name: Heracles / BTCUSDT spot 4h

parameters.parameter_load: explicit source buy_params overrides IntParameter default16; no external parameter JSON/config override; no hyperopt

signal.no_volume_guard: no additional strategy volume predicate; input QA independently requires positive activity
signal.nan_policy: ta.dropna on date/OHLCV only; actual 0 rows removed; any real deletion is blocker. Indicator NaN retained and yields false entry. No bfill/ffill.
signal.indicator_units: DCP dimensionless [0,1]; original-version KCW is percentage width*100, not ATR modern Keltner

risk.roi_clock: integer floor wall-clock minutes from effective entry open (14:00 for outage bucket) to effective current bar open; original minute keys retained
risk.roi_inside_bar_policy: select ROI tier at effective observable open and hold it for entire bar; if next minute boundary is inside interval before next observable open, defer new tier until that open if still held; never use whole-bar high for a tier unavailable at bar open. This can understate or otherwise alter exits vs minute replay, and is not exact Freqtrade runtime replication.
risk.roi_execution_slippage: sell reference at target or favorable raw opening gap, then 2bps adverse slip; zero ROI can realize a small net loss
risk.stop_threshold_formula: entry_fill*(1-0.256), sell costs added; gap-through executes at worse observed open
samebar_priority: if flat: due entry at effective open
for existing/new position: open<=stop -> stop gap; else open>=current ROI target -> ROI gap
otherwise low<=stop first; else high>=current ROI target -> ROI
ROI tier transition inside observation interval cannot act within that interval
no reentry after exit during same bar
risk.boundary_logging: candidate transition while position exists at opening; does not assert still held at later boundary; next observation honors 14:00 outage resume

execution.fill: full fractional fills; next 4h observed open, market proxy plus adverse slippage
execution.known_halt: 2023-03-24 11:27–14:00 UTC; 12:00 native bar uses 14:00 1h resumption-open proxy. 08:00 intrabar interval ends11:26:59.999; 12:00 interval starts14:00. No tick precision.
execution.terminal: no forced liquidation; holdings marked to final raw close, hypothetical closing fee not charged
execution.missing_microstructure: historical lot size, min notional, queue, partial fills, liquidity and all-history downtime unproven

age_filter.proxy: historical exchange announcement confirms >176 elapsed days by first possible strategy order, continuous listing assumed; not original recent100 daily candle count
age_filter.universe: fixed predeclared single BTCUSDT; not author pairlist or point-in-time universe

input.reason_not_trusted_loader: explicit spot task does not use perpetual V3 bundle; equivalent row/integrity QA but strict core finality not established, no TRUSTED or promotion claim

evaluation.initial_state: all cash; warmup indicators only, no warmup pending signal. First possible strategy entry2023-01-01 04:00UTC

benchmark: same BTCUSDT at first evaluation open,95% inclusive cash budget,same8bps fee and2bps slip,no risk exits,no terminal forced sale

metrics.max_drawdown: all unsampled4h close equities including initial capital, not intrabar
metrics.sharpe_daily: UTC end-of-day returns including initial equity, sample std ddof1,sqrt365,rf0
metrics.exposure: bar-close position fraction, not exact elapsed time

dependencies.original_runtime: unknown; ta0.11.0 pinned for this instance
